layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful sugary confectionery, bright, glossy and silly. layers.text: Subject: Confectioner, a chunky cute living caramel sweet who is a pastry cook: the whole body is one big round ball of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #d9a05b, with a hard white highlight, with no separate head and no neck; the face is on the ball itself, big round brass goggles with pale lenses over its eyes and a small friendly smile; a tall white puffy baker's hat on top; a white baker's apron with one cotton-candy pink pocket tied round its middle; two tiny stubby caramel arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet; it holds one oversized balloon whisk with a pale wire head and a pink handle upright in one hand; no crown, no coat and no hair; simple shapes and very few details.
The caramel ball is drawn large: about 42 pixels wide.
